english.title: Fail to stop / permit search of vehicle claiming an exemption from payment of a Mersey tunnel toll
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to allow

(A)_[a Mersey Tunnels police officer]_
(B)_[an authorised officer]_

to stop, inspect and search a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), brought

(E)_[into the tunnels]_
(F)_[onto the tunnels' approaches or marshalling areas]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL / APPROACHES / MARSHALLING AREA..), the officer having reason to suspect that it claimed a concession or exemption from payment of the appropriate toll to which it is not entitled
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(b) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
